tonight.headline: 50-50 — and Footballers now hold Tuten's backup
body: Bad news first. Tuten's ankle is a high sprain he has managed since Week 8; Coen will judge Wednesday's and Thursday's practices and said only 'We'll see' (Roundtable via Yahoo, 25 Nov 04:42Z). Warren loses his quarterback: Pittsburgh benched Aaron Rodgers overnight and Mason Rudolph starts Friday (team statement, Yahoo 25 Nov 04:15Z). ESPN has not repriced it — Warren is still 14.8 in every snapshot since. You are 4-7.

At 02:11 CDMX Footballers claimed Chris Rodriguez Jr., the Jaguars back who starts if Tuten sits. ESPN has it 128.6 to 129.5, 50%. Your lineup is the projection lineup; nothing to move today. The decisions left are Warren if ESPN reprices him before Friday 14:00, and Tuten at 10:30 Sunday.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Bowers plays Sunday night (Kubiak 'optimistic', 23 Nov), Tuten sits and Rodriguez scores for them off their bench only if they start him, and Pittsburgh's offence stalls under Rudolph in the slate's lowest-total game.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Bowers ruled out before Sunday night, or Tuten practising fully by Friday. If ESPN cuts Warren below Diggs' 12.7 before Friday 14:00, the projection lineup changes and so do you.

case.label: The player
case.body: A high ankle sprain managed since Week 8, re-aggravated when he was stepped on twice in Week 11. Jacksonville are 14.5-point favourites; Yahoo's Boone calls it a chance to rest him.
